derivationPipeline.determinism: Same inputs + same software version = byte-identical outputs. Every run emits: input manifest (with SHA-256 per input), software version, output manifest (with SHA-256 per output), and a run provenance hash.
derivationPipeline.order: parcel -> terrain -> building extrusion -> elevation sampling -> flood-depth computation
derivationPipeline.registration: Tilesets register in artifacts/tsm-3d-tiles-fabric-v1.json with status, authorityClass, and provenance. Unvalidated tilesets are never registered.
derivationPipeline.tilesetValidation: Every generated tileset is validated against OGC 3D Tiles 1.1 (bounding volumes, content URIs, geometric error) before registration. Validation report stored alongside the tileset.

globalRules.deterministicDerivation: LOD derivation must be reproducible: same inputs + same software version = byte-identical outputs (SHA-256 verifiable).
globalRules.failClosed: If a required input is unavailable, the object is emitted at the highest LOD its available inputs support, with the shortfall explicitly recorded. Never emit a higher LOD than the inputs justify.
globalRules.lowerLevelsAreValid: Each LOD is a complete, useful product on its own. Higher LODs extend; they do not invalidate lower ones.
globalRules.missingMeansUnavailable: A missing input is recorded as UNAVAILABLE, never zero, never interpolated, never invented.
globalRules.noProvenanceLaundering: Provisional, draft, or derived data is never promoted to authoritative. Authority classes: AUTHORITATIVE, DERIVED, SCREENING, PROVISIONAL.

governingAxiom: Technology informs people; it does not silently govern people. Human authority remains final.

accuracyExpectations.uncertainty: Recorded per object: groundElevationSource, heightEstimationMethod, confidence: SCREENING.
accuracyExpectations.vertical: Terrain DEM accuracy as-sourced (3DEP QL2 RMSEz <= 0.33 ft non-vegetated). Extrusion height is an ESTIMATE with no stated accuracy unless sourced.

LOD1.completeMeans: Every parcel with available geometry AND terrain has an extruded block; parcels missing either input are listed as unavailable in the manifest. No invented geometry exists in the tileset.

derivation.software: Documented per run (script name + version + content hash of inputs).
steps: Sample terrain elevation at parcel centroid (building-ground elevation sampling).
Estimate structure height: fixed default (e.g. single-story 10 ft) unless a verified height attribute exists. Estimated heights are labeled ESTIMATED, never stated as measured.
Extrude parcel polygon to estimated height; seat base at sampled ground elevation.
Emit glTF 2.0 GLB per tile region; register in OGC 3D Tiles 1.1 tileset.

LOD1.description: 2D parcel polygons extruded to an estimated structure height, seated on terrain. Sufficient for per-parcel flood exposure screening.
LOD1.name: Parcel blocks
LOD1.notClaimed: Roof form, openings, textures, interior. Per-parcel BFE. Certified elevations.

requiredInputs.fallback: UNAVAILABLE — parcel excluded from LOD1 set, recorded in derivation manifest
UNAVAILABLE — ground elevation recorded as unavailable; no extrusion performed
requiredInputs.source: USGS 3DEP-derived Terrain-RGB tileset (z8-z12, 478 tiles) or equivalent DEM

accuracyExpectations.uncertainty: confidence: SCREENING. Roof form never stated as surveyed.
accuracyExpectations.vertical: Height estimates are SCREENING-grade (DSM noise, vegetation). Roof form is approximate classification, not surveyed geometry.

LOD2.completeMeans: Every LOD1 object with an available footprint + height estimate carries LOD2 geometry; objects without remain at LOD1 with the gap recorded. No footprint is invented where LiDAR shows none.

steps: Intersect LiDAR building footprints with LOD1 parcel blocks (many-to-one allowed; orphans recorded).
Estimate roof form from height distribution: flat / gable / hip approximation ONLY (no dormers, no chimneys).
Re-emit GLB with roof geometry; retain LOD1 attributes; add roofForm (APPROXIMATE) and footprintSource.

LOD2.description: LOD1 extended with LiDAR-derived building footprints and height estimates, plus approximate roof-form geometry. Improves flood-depth-per-structure estimates over parcel-block extrusion.
LOD2.name: Building shapes
LOD2.notClaimed: Openings, textures, materials, interiors. Survey-grade roof geometry.

outputSchema.geometry: glTF 2.0 GLB, OGC 3D Tiles 1.1 tileset (separate from LOD1 tileset)

requiredInputs.fallback: Cannot produce LOD2 without LOD1 base — fail closed.
UNAVAILABLE — object remains at LOD1, recorded in manifest
requiredInputs.source: LiDAR-derived building footprints (NOT YET IN-HAND for Posey County)

requiredInputs.fallback: UNAVAILABLE — roof form omitted, flat-top block retained at LOD1
requiredInputs.source: LiDAR first-return / DSM-DTM differencing (NOT YET IN-HAND)

accuracyExpectations.openings: ANNOTATED positions unless field-verified; never stated as as-built.
accuracyExpectations.uncertainty: confidence per attribute: VERIFIED | ANNOTATED | SCREENING.

LOD3.completeMeans: LOD3 exists only for structures with supporting data. The manifest lists every LOD2 object and its LOD3 status (PRESENT | DATA_GAP). A sparse LOD3 set is a correct LOD3 set.

steps: For structures with facade imagery: place opening planes (doors/windows) on LOD2 shell; openings are ANNOTATED unless field-verified.
Apply textures only from the captured imagery of that structure — never stock textures presented as real.

LOD3.description: Individual building models with openings (doors/windows as geometry or annotated planes) and texture where source imagery exists. Produced ONLY where supporting data exists — never extrapolated to unsurveyed structures.
LOD3.name: Detailed structures
LOD3.notClaimed: Interiors (CityGML LOD4 scope — explicitly out of TSM scope). As-built certification. Universal coverage.

outputSchema.geometry: glTF 2.0 GLB with PBR materials where imagery exists, OGC 3D Tiles 1.1
perObjectAttributes: openings: annotated[] (each: type, position, verified: bool)

requiredInputs.fallback: Cannot produce LOD3 without LOD2 base — fail closed.

requiredInputs.source: Georeferenced oblique/ground imagery or photogrammetry (NOT YET IN-HAND)
Field survey / measured drawings where available (NOT YET IN-HAND)

accuracyExpectations.depth: Screening-grade unless WSE source is a validated model run AND ground elevation is surveyed. Uncertainty is always stated; a depth without uncertainty is a defect.
accuracyExpectations.uncertainty: Quantified per object. The twin reports what it does not know.
accuracyExpectations.wse: Gage-derived WSE requires validated datum conversion (gage zero 352.67 ft NAVD88 for 03378500 per USGS SIR 2016-5119). Discharge-to-WSE conversion without a validated rating is prohibited.

LOD4.completeMeans: Every LOD1+ object carries a LOD4 record: geometry reference, depth (or explicit UNAVAILABLE), uncertainty, and provenance state. 'Complete' includes complete honesty about gaps.

steps: Parcel -> terrain -> building derivation: for each object, sample building-ground elevation (lowest adjacent grade estimate from DEM at structure footprint).
Flood-WSE -> building/parcel-depth computation: depthFt = wseFtNavd88 - groundElevationFtNavd88. If either term is unavailable, depth is UNAVAILABLE (not zero).
Attach explicit uncertainty/provenance state per object (see outputSchema).
Emit operational objects (JSON + optional GLB overlay); deterministic from inputs.

LOD4.description: Operational digital twin objects: LOD1-3 geometry fused with flood simulation results, sensor/hydrology data, and explicit uncertainty/provenance state. This is the level at which the twin answers 'how deep at this structure' — with quantified uncertainty, not a single magic number.
LOD4.name: Application integration
LOD4.notClaimed: Regulatory determinations (BFE, LOMA outcomes). Real-time state (snapshot-only by policy). Survey-certified elevations (unless independently certified).

outputSchema.geometry: Reference to LOD1-3 tileset object + computed overlay
perObjectAttributes: floodDepthFt (or null; null means UNAVAILABLE, never 0.0 by default)
depthUncertaintyFt (quantified where possible; null with reason where not)
humanAuthorityGate: required for any operational decision use

requiredInputs.fallback: Object excluded from LOD4 until geometry exists — fail closed.
requiredInputs.source: Highest available LOD tileset per object (LOD1 minimum)

requiredInputs.authorityClass: DERIVED (model) — never AUTHORITATIVE for regulatory use
requiredInputs.fallback: UNAVAILABLE — depth not computed; object shows geometry only with 'no WSE' state. NEVER synthesize WSE from discharge without a validated rating.
requiredInputs.source: Validated water-surface elevation: 2D hydraulic model output OR gage-derived WSE with datum conversion (NOT YET VALIDATED as a feed)

requiredInputs.fallback: UNAVAILABLE — last-known values shown with timestamp, clearly labeled stale; never presented as live
requiredInputs.source: User-triggered USGS snapshot (13-station registry); no automatic polling

referenceFrames.note: BFE 375.0 is the Point Township target value, not per-parcel verified. LAG 377.20 ft is owner-supplied, not survey-certified.

safetyBoundary: LOD outputs are screening/engineering-support products. They never substitute for FEMA effective regulatory mapping, survey-certified elevations, HEC-RAS hydraulic results used for design, or professional engineering determinations. Visualization is never evidence.
scope: Flood-focused digital twin object detail levels for the Tri-State Systems Manager. This is an APPLICATION-level contract: each LOD defines what data, provenance, and computation a twin object carries. It is NOT CityGML LOD4 (interior rooms/furniture) — TSM deliberately targets LOD1/LOD2 for flood work and does not claim interior modeling.
title: TSM Application LOD Contract v1
